name: afadin, adherens junction formation factor

function.text: AFDN encodes afadin. Annotated molecular activities include cadherin binding and actin filament binding. It participates in signal transduction and cell adhesion.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: AFDN is a fusion partner of KMT2A in acute myeloid leukemia, including rearrangements involving chromosomes 6 and 11.
